name: plane-workflow
description: Configurable Plane planning, project briefings, work-item relations, lifecycles, and report exports for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, inspect, relate, and complete Plane work safely.
interface.longDescription: Set up a secure Plane connection, then inspect, plan, create, relate, start, complete, cancel, audit, organize, and export work through configurable advisory or strict project profiles.
defaultPrompt: Set up Plane Workflow securely in this client.

Create a well-planned Plane task from this request.
Show me which Plane work items need attention today.
Mark one Plane work item as blocked by another.
Start this planned Plane item now and record its actual start date.
Complete this started Plane item with a factual summary and verification.
Cancel this Plane item and record the factual reason.
Export this project's backlog and in-progress items as a PDF.
